g.text: Tab/arrows move Enter load F2 monitor F10 quit
# DC motor plant (libs/plants/dcmotor): duty steps from 0 to 0.5 at t = 0.
# 0.2 mN*m is applied at t = 0.5 s. fmus/dcmotor.fmu is built with the run
# DC motor plant in real time until it is stopped: for steering it by hand
# Python client). Starts at rest; set duty and load_torque while it runs.
││max_overruns = 1000000 # a desktop is not real time: count late steps, do│
# Input to output wiring: the output follows the input, which steps from 0
# T12 tip plant (libs/plants/t12): the heater switches at 5 Hz with about
# is on when >= 0.5), and a joint (0.1 W/K) is touched at t = 6 s. fmus/t1
# T12 tip plant in real time until it is stopped: for steering it by hand
# Python client). Starts cold with the heater off; the heater is on while
# load_wk is a joint touching the tip (W/K, e.g. 0.1). Try a pulse signal
# high 1, period 0.2 s, duty 0.5). The log grows by about 60 kB per second
t 0.000 s steps 0 overruns 0 step max 0.0 us wake max 0.0 us Start Stop Unload
samples come in while it runs
s start x stop u unload space check c uncheck all m one/many graphs w/Enter write g signal Esc close F
